verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms SendGrid has dynamic transactional templates with multiple versions and dashboard-based sending (sendgrid-docs-10, sendgrid-docs-27), but the pack contains no documentation of the actual templating syntax (Handlebars-style merge fields, conditionals, loops) nor any explicit preview/test-render workflow. missing for 10: documented templating language syntax (merge tags, {{#if}}/{{#each}} conditionals and loops), explicit test-render/preview feature documentation, independent corroboration of template authoring experience.
